candidates.snippet: @Frontex Arms companies provide the tech, Frontex provides the coordinates, militias do the rest. This isn't border protection – it's the military-industrial complex at sea. We keep watching. (4/4)

@Frontex Italy has been backing these militias since the 2017 Memorandum with vessels, training and funding – an estimated €1 billion+ in total. What Rome pays for: violent interceptions at sea and forced returns to detention, torture & extortion in Libya.(3/4)

The drone itself issued a Mayday Relay – then coordinated with Libya. We've seen it over the central Med since March, untrackable. Operated by @Frontex, built by Leonardo, Italy's biggest arms company. (2/4)
